definitions.explanation: A system of communication used by humans.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{言語|げんご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: Learning a new language takes time.

notes:
{言語|げんご} is the formal and academic term for "language" as a system of communication. It appears frequently in scholarly, technical, and official contexts.

COMPOUNDS:
- {言語|げんご}⟦{学|がく}→〜学：09846_gaku⟧: linguistics
- {言語|げんご}⟦{能力|のうりょく}→能力：03541_nouryoku⟧: language ability/proficiency
- {言語|げんご}⟦{障害|しょうがい}→障害：03228_shougai⟧: speech/language disorder
- {言語|げんご}⟦{療法|りょうほう}→療法：13615_ryouhou⟧: speech therapy
- ⟦{公用|こうよう}→公用：28016_kouyou⟧{言語|げんご}: official language

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {言語|げんご}: formal/academic; refers to language as a system
- ⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧: everyday word; also covers words, speech, and expressions
- ⟦{国語|こくご}→国語：02739_kokugo⟧: national language (school subject in Japan)
- ⟦{語|ご}→〜語：09841_go⟧: language as a suffix (⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧, ⟦{英語|えいご}→英語：02274_eigo⟧)
